descriptions.text: A root-cause, functional lens: detailed labs, unhurried visits, and a clear plan.
Functional lab testing beyond the annual physical — hormones, gut, thyroid, metabolic.
Two full hours on your case. Evidence-informed care from doctors who listen.
Cash-pay clinic, HSA/FSA accepted. No membership. Telehealth across MN & WI.
Integrative medicine in Hopkins — conventional insight plus natural therapies, one plan.
Creating health with science and nature. Root-cause evaluation with functional labs.
Unhurried integrative care from a husband-wife ND team. Free 10-minute intro call.
Whole-person integrative medicine for the west metro. In person or MN & WI telehealth.
